answer: Work waits on the hollow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the island of the next round. By the vault of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
